newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end weak on a softer gold price.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end weak on a softer gold price.

text.p: South African shares ended weaker, after a morning surge ran out of steam at noon amid profit-taking and a weak gold price.
The market started firm as funds put money in the market and it was buoyed by a strong Wall Street on Friday night.
Dealers said weaker London and Tokyo stocks also contributed to the weakness in local shares.
Blue chip and electronic stocks enjoyed some buying on Monday but interest dwindled as the gold price weakened.
Overall volumes were fairly high at 600 million rand but dealers said it was not much considering the increase in JSE volumes since the introduction of the electronic trading system.
The overall index lost 5.5 points to 6,777.4, the industrial index fell 2.6 points to 8,177.8 and the gold index lost 7.1 points to 1419.1.
